request: 配置 SPI 主机，时钟 10MHz，8 位数据
config:
```yaml
Spi:
  general:
    dev_error_detect: true
  SpiHwUnit:
    - id: 0
      name: SPI_0
      mode: MASTER
      clock_frequency_hz: 10000000
      data_width: 8
      clock_polarity: LOW
      clock_phase: EDGE_1
      cs_polarity: LOW
```

request: 配置 SPI 用于连接外部 Flash，时钟 20MHz，带 DMA
config:
```yaml
Spi:
  SpiHwUnit:
    - id: 0
      name: SPI_Flash
      mode: MASTER
      clock_frequency_hz: 20000000
      data_width: 8
      clock_polarity: LOW
      clock_phase: EDGE_1
      cs_polarity: LOW
      enable_dma: true
      dma_tx_channel: 0
      dma_rx_channel: 1
```
